text:
alex: seeing a cluster of GPU warmup failures in eu-west-1 since ~08:10 UTC. nodes start, attempt to fetch keys, keystore-proxy OOMs and restarts -> node join fails. attaching short logs.

alex: ```
keystore-proxy | panic: runtime: out of memory
keystore-proxy | goroutine 92 [running]:
keystore-proxy | runtime.throw(0x4f2b2a, 0x16)
keystore-proxy |    /usr/local/go/src/runtime/panic.go:1116 +0x72 fp=0xc0004d5f10 sp=0xc0004d5ee0 pc=0x4376f2
keystore-proxy | decrypt: RPC error: context deadline exceeded
keystore-proxy | 2025-05-18T08:11:03Z keystore: cache prefetch 512 entries -> mem spike
```

priya: pinging keystore/devex, any recent keystore config changes or canary rolled? @sam can you check memory requests/limits?

infrabot: ALERT: keystore-proxy eu-west-1 pod/keystore-proxy-7f9c restarted 12 times in 6m; image: rwn/keystore:v3.8.1

sam: pulling logs now. quick check: memory limit is 512Mi, requests 256Mi for the keystore pods in eu-west. looks low given recent prefetch change in v3.8.1.

morgan: also seeing audit-shipper lag to s3 in same timeframe -> s3 429 spikes. if audit shipper backpressure hits keystore it could cause more retries and caching pressure.

alex: adding quick diagnostic commands:

alex: ```
kubectl -n infra logs pod/keystore-proxy-7f9c --tail=200
kubectl -n infra get hpa,deploy keystore-proxy -o wide
k get pods -l role=gpu-warmup -n fleet
# observing mem usage via metrics: keystore_proxy_memory_bytes{region="eu-west-1"}
```

sam: pragmatic mitigations: 1) bump keystore memory limit to 1Gi in eu-west canary 2) scale keystore to 3 replicas behind LB 3) pause warm-pool draining to avoid rolling join attempts. I'll do a canary deploy on a single AZ.

priya: agreed, do canary first. morgan can you validate audit shipper QPS? if we need to drop audit sampling temporarily that's fine for the immediate window.

morgan: checking shipper config. current putQPS per worker = 150, but s3 reports 429s peaking. can throttle retry backoff or increase concurrency but that will affect cost. proposal: drop audit sampling from 100% to 25% for 2h in eu-west.

sam: deploy-bot starting canary: canary id c-20250518-01, target: keystore-proxy eu-west AZ-a, new resources mem: 1Gi, req 512Mi.

deploy-bot: Canary c-20250518-01 started by sam — patch applied to infra/keystore-proxy (eu-west only). Monitoring hooks enabled.

infrabot: METRIC: keystore_proxy_memory_used increased then stabilized after bump. restart count for canary pod reduced to 0 in last 3m.

alex: after canary, 2/3 GPU warmup nodes in that AZ completed join. one remaining failing node shows decrypt timeout (still).

morgan: audit sampling cut to 25% in eu-west. s3 429s dropped by ~70% per dashboard.

sam: rolling the bump to all keystore pods in eu-west. doing a 2m rate limit on the rollout.

alex: cost note — mem bump across eu-west keystore set (10 pods) estimated +$0.18/hr (~$4.32/day). tagging cost-centre infra-warmup.

priya: ok for the charge, prefer reliability here. next: long-term fixes?

sam: followups: - add guardrail to keystore prefetch (limit to 64 entries per request) - improve backpressure handling and exponential backoff for decrypt RPCs - add HPA rule on memory + custom metric keystore_cache_fill

morgan: open task to increase shipper resiliency and add local buffering to avoid hitting s3 QPS hard limits.

alex: I'll open an infra-issue for the code changes and schedule an oncall follow-up. https://redwood.internal/issue/INF-1234

sam: patch roll complete. monitoring shows warmup success across eu-west for the last 12m. :thumbsup:

priya: thanks. I'll leave this thread open 6h for observation then mark resolved. please post if any regressions.

alex: noted, keeping watch. thanks all.
